GAME 251: Introduction to programming 2D Games with HTML5 and Javascript.
GAME 420: Develop the habits of successful game designers - playing games thoughtfully, and documenting those thoughts.
GAME 430: In Modeling and Simulation, students will develop an understanding of the systems, processes, tools, and implications of this field.
GAME 434: Upper level course examining the core psychological principles as they apply to the topic of games.
GAME 450: Autonomously generating object behavior and content in games.
